e02daad20667c24c75e3.en: Shen Boyang, a Democratic Progressive Party candidate for mayor of Taipei 12 years ago, recently dug up an article discussing drugs. Lan Ying frenziedly attacked Shen in the past and advocated "equating drugs with drugs". Shen Boyang bitterly criticized Jiang Wan 'an Li Sichuan for maliciously creating panic and said that he could debate the drug policy with these two people at once, "anytime." However, Jiang Wan 'an later said that anti-drugs are a matter of right and wrong. Either the debate can have positive or negative choices, or he firmly stands in the position of anti-drugs and zero tolerance for drugs. "Full text..."

In his speech, Xiao Meiqin said that it was a pleasure to be invited by the Eulogy Church to attend the 77th Anniversary Joint Thanksgiving Service of the Eulogy Church together with the Speaker Tong Wei.
